sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of pramoxine during breastfeeding. Direct ingestion of pramoxine has resulted mostly of nausea and vomiting, with no serious toxicity; however, it should be wiped off thoroughly prior to nursing if it is being applied to the breast or nipple area.
